Detect peaks in an FID trace

detect_fid_peaks.Rd

Detect peaks in an FID trace

Usage

detect_fid_peaks(fid, min_snr = NULL)

Arguments

fid

List with numeric rt and intensity (e.g. exp$fid).

min_snr

Numeric; minimum apex height as a multiple of the noise. NULL uses the moosaic.peak_min_height_snr option.

Value

A tibble with columns peak_id, apex_rt, start_rt, end_rt, height (above the estimated baseline) and shoulder (logical; the second derivative shows an unresolved extra component inside the peak; heuristic, and conservative for noisy or narrow peaks). Zero rows when nothing is detected.

Details

Detection runs on a smoothed, baseline-corrected copy; the input is never modified. Maxima that do not rise at least half the SNR threshold above their neighbouring valley are discarded as noise.

Examples

rt <- seq(0, 2, length.out = 2000)
fid <- list(rt = rt, intensity = 100 * exp(-0.5 * ((rt - 1) / 0.03)^2))
detect_fid_peaks(fid)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   peak_id apex_rt start_rt end_rt height shoulder
#>     <int>   <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl> <lgl>   
#> 1       1    1.00    0.939   1.06   75.8 FALSE
